April 26, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Hilltop Holdings Inc decreased its stake in Netflix Inc (NFLX) by 47.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hilltop Holdings Inc sold 1,591 shares as the company’s stock rose 58.31% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,727 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $332,000, down from 3,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hilltop Holdings Inc who had been investing in Netflix Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $133.45 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 108.73% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.18% the S&P500.
